mainText: Hello, Verona! At 8 PM, here is today's balanced dish: we have 71 degrees under overcast skies at Harriet Park. The moon is in a waning crescent phase, and we will see an overnight low of 60 degrees with no rain predicted.

The Verona Police Department arrested a 34-year-old Madison woman on September 4 following reports of an inappropriate relationship with a student in 2019. Additionally, road construction is moving into phase two this week on Highway M, which will shift traffic into the eastbound lanes with one lane maintained in each direction.

There is plenty to do this week in Verona. Today, enjoy live music at Bailey's Run Vineyard and Wisconsin Brewing Company. Tomorrow, you can head to Insight Wellness for yoga. Looking ahead, Tuesday brings trivia at Hop Haus, Wisconsin Brewing Company, and Paddy Mac's, plus the Downtown Farmer's Market.
Regarding the weekly police update, an investigation began after the school district reported an incident on Sunday, August 30, which led to the arrest of a teacher for sexual assault.
Today's flavor of the day is Chocolate Covered Strawberry. The store is currently open and will remain open until 10 PM tonight.
